script: (() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.startPlaying(true); g.simulate(0.5); const log = []; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { g.inner.toggle(); g.simulate(0.2 + Math.random() * 0.6); } g.simulate(2); log.push(['afterFlip', g.inner.on, g.peds.list.filter(p => p.creature).length]); g.input.typed = 'TOOLUP'; g.simulate(0.2); g.player.inventory.select('rifle'); if (!g.inner.on) { g.inner.toggle(); g.simulate(2); } for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) { const c = g.peds.list.find(p => p.creature && !p.dead); if (!c) break; g.lookAtPoint(c.pos.x, c.pos.y + 1.2, c.pos.z); g.simulate(0.4, ['Mouse2'], ['Mouse0']); g.simulate(0.3, ['Mouse2'], ['Mouse0']); } log.push(['killed', g.peds.list.filter(p => p.creature && p.dead).length, 'hp', Math.round(g.player.health), 'stars', g.police.stars]); g.simulate(6); log.push(['afterAttack', 'hp', Math.round(g.player.health), g.state]); const fr = g.layout.frost; g.player.pos.set(fr.roadX + 4, 0, -1000); g.simulate(1); g.inner.toggle(); g.simulate(4); log.push(['frost+inner', g.debugState()]); g.inner.toggle(); g.simulate(3); log.push(['back', g.debugState()]); return log; })()
